同じversionの新しい課題では、原記録のみが6/6件、保存した判断を加えた条件が6/6件受理されました。 受理数が同じだったため、判断を加える主効果は確認できていません。

全probeには、現在の3つの操作すべての実出力を、toy入力で一度に見られる診断を用意しました。実際に36/36件が診断を使っています。この出力だけでも正しい操作を識別できる可能性があり、保存した判断による成功率の上乗せは切り分けられていません。

経験と判断を分けて比べる。

6つの人工historyは、A：どの識別子を同一とみなしてまとめるか、B：途中状態からのSQLite取込を各3件です。Bの途中状態は設計した入力で、過去のprocess crashを観測したものではありません。操作名は意味が推測できないIDにし、3つの操作の挙動は作業結果や診断から確かめます。教師役のAIが各3課題を2回、合計36回実行し、作業結果から自分で書いた判断をnative LREに保存・review・readbackしました。その後、新しい36のAI contextで比較しました。保存された文章を次に渡す試験で、モデルの重みを更新する学習ではありません。

同じversion／変更後versionの各phaseで、3条件×6historyの18個の初期POLICYをすべて固定。その後、同じ6原記録への取得権と1回のcurrent toy診断を提供し、同じcontextの18個のFINALをすべて固定してから、各1回のtarget実操作または棄権を記録しました。

変更後versionでは、旧versionだけで正しい操作を選んだか、診断を要求したか、最終的に成功したかを別に示します。「操作の変更」は、初期に選んだ操作が非nullの場合だけを数えます。初期nullから最終操作を選ぶことは数えないため、原記録のみの変更0は「feedbackを使わなかった」という意味ではありません。初期の選択、最終選択、stateが正しいこと、操作完了、受理は別の指標です。

成功と、読んだ量を分ける。

原記録のみ → 原記録＋判断の順で、同じversionでは追加取得が32回 → 10回、最初の課題＋feedbackの合計が124,986 → 86,383 bytesでした。 変更後のversionでは追加取得が36回 → 8回、最初の課題＋feedbackの合計が135,634 → 80,335 bytesでした。

集計が小さくても、全historyで小さかったとは限りません。W04（変更後のversion）は追加取得が6回 → 6回で、判断ありのpacketは2,070 bytes多くなりました。

      "text": "Observed at current_version v1: every trial completed with exit code 0 and status success, but two round-one artifacts failed independent contract validation. On case-928e0c58aefe, op-74444a2e0829 imported the missing prefix and suffix IDs and retained the outside ID, yet replaced both original committed values with source values; validation rejected that artifact under the preserve-committed contract. On the same case in round two, op-61a1ad3bbfbf preserved both committed values, recovered the missing ID before checkpoint 3, added the suffix ID, and retained the outside ID; validation accepted. On source-authoritative case-7785b78d62ed, op-61a1ad3bbfbf retained the two old committed values and validation rejected it, whereas op-74444a2e0829 wrote the required source values, added the new IDs, retained the outside ID, and validation accepted. Op-36ef9328143a was accepted in both rounds on case-9a261f6208d1, whose entire checkpoint prefix already existed with values equal to the source. These observations support this conditional v1 choice: when committed values must prevail, prefer op-61a1ad3bbfbf; when source values must prevail, prefer op-74444a2e0829. Those are inferences for similarly structured inputs, not verified claims about every input or internal implementation. Op-36ef9328143a is directly supported only for the tested complete, matching prefix; its conflict handling and missing-prefix recovery remain unknown. All six artifacts retained their outside ID, and the accepted artifacts satisfied the requested union and payload precedence in their respective cases. Completion alone did not establish correctness. Other versions and untested input conditions remain uncalibrated."

      "source_kind": "judgment",
      "text": "Observed for the supplied v1 cases: all six operations completed successfully and preserved all eight original records and member IDs, but process success alone did not imply contract acceptance. In round one, op-c68b03671eac merged 0036, 36 and +36, and merged 0037 with 37, leaving space-bearing keys separate; exact-identity validation rejected it. Op-6a6177cda758 returned eight singletons on the numeric-identity case and was rejected because numeric-equivalent keys remained separate. Op-8135b82a94b7 grouped the outer-space variants of 0039 and 40 while separating 0039, 39 and +39; its whitespace-stripping case was accepted. In round two, op-6a6177cda758 was accepted on exact identity, op-8135b82a94b7 was accepted again on the same whitespace case with the same artifact hash, and op-c68b03671eac was accepted on the numeric case, grouping 0042/42/+42 and 0043/43 while leaving space-bearing keys separate. These observations support choosing op-6a6177cda758 for exact-string contracts, op-8135b82a94b7 for outer-whitespace contracts without numeric conversion, and op-c68b03671eac for whole-string ASCII integer equivalence without trimming, conditional on the tested v1 behavior. Those descriptions are inferred operation properties, not inspected implementations. Repeated identical keys, non-space Unicode whitespace, negative and zero values, large integers, non-ASCII digits, other nonmatching strings, and changed versions remain unverified."

    "initial_judgment": {
      "native_status": "retained",
      "provenance_sha256": "b64972b79b702aa857d2e39ee7946f70227d8329e7ed9720d9475ca77fc28d77",
      "source_id": "judgment-b64972b79b702aa857d2e39ee7946f70227d8329e7ed9720d9475ca77fc28d77",
      "source_kind": "judgment",
      "text": "For current_version v1, distinguish completeness from value precedence before selecting an operation. Observed: op-d2c64b0a8b6d was accepted on both preservation cases, retaining existing values and outside rows while adding missing IDs. In case-b1ab5b76ee86 it recovered an ID before checkpoint 3 despite conflicting source values. Op-a2227054a8a7 was accepted on the matching-value baseline and the source-authoritative case; in the latter it changed both existing prefix rows to source values and retained the outside row. These observations support choosing op-d2c64b0a8b6d for analogous preservation work and op-a2227054a8a7 for analogous source-authoritative work, with extrapolation beyond those inputs still an inference.\nObserved failures: op-3915cd13babb completed its process in both trials but was rejected by independent contract validation. It left a missing prefix ID absent in the preservation gap case and retained obsolete committed prefix values in the source-authoritative case. Skipping the checkpoint prefix is consistent with these outputs, but the implementation was not inspected. A checkpoint alone is therefore insufficient evidence of either complete prefix presence or correct prefix payloads. No tested condition establishes an accepted use of this operation.\nAll six outputs retained the outside row and showed no duplicate IDs, but this does not establish behavior for every input arrangement. The matching-value baseline cannot by itself distinguish preservation from source replacement. Check the final ID union, uniqueness, outside-row retention, and contract-specific payload values; process success alone did not establish correctness. All observations concern v1 only."
    },

      "source_kind": "judgment",
      "text": "For current_version v1, choose by the requested payload precedence and by observed checkpoint completeness. Observed: op-e30c8efa3b18 passed both preserve-committed cases. In case-7f0012cb7d7a it inserted the missing input record before checkpoint 3, added the final input record, preserved the two differing committed values, and retained the outside record. On source-authoritative case-6910a46a6503 it still retained the two committed values; its process completed successfully but independent validation rejected the artifact. Thus it is supported for analogous preserve-committed imports and contradicted for this source-authoritative conflict case. Observed: op-14abd3b15139 passed the source-authoritative case, replacing both conflicting committed input values, adding both new IDs, and retaining the outside ID. This supports selecting it for analogous v1 source-authoritative inputs; its behavior on a missing checkpoint-prefix record or a preserve-committed contract remains untested here. Observed: op-dea403be5bde passed case-a7ba3cc7c70d where the checkpoint prefix was complete and values already agreed. It failed case-7f0012cb7d7a by omitting event-9e7a2083 before checkpoint 3, despite process success. The hypothesis that it trusts or skips the checkpoint prefix explains these two artifacts, but its implementation and general behavior were not inspected. Do not use its successful complete-prefix run as evidence that it repairs prefix gaps or resolves arbitrary payload conflicts. Inference: op-e30c8efa3b18 is the better-supported preserve-committed choice when prefix completeness is uncertain, and op-14abd3b15139 is the better-supported source-authoritative choice under the tested v1 conditions. These are conditional selections from six executions, not guarantees for other versions or untested inputs."
    },

      "source_kind": "judgment",
      "text": "Observed for the supplied v1 cases: all six operations completed successfully and preserved all eight original records and member IDs, but process success alone did not imply contract acceptance. In round one, op-c68b03671eac merged 0036, 36 and +36, and merged 0037 with 37, leaving space-bearing keys separate; exact-identity validation rejected it. Op-6a6177cda758 returned eight singletons on the numeric-identity case and was rejected because numeric-equivalent keys remained separate. Op-8135b82a94b7 grouped the outer-space variants of 0039 and 40 while separating 0039, 39 and +39; its whitespace-stripping case was accepted. In round two, op-6a6177cda758 was accepted on exact identity, op-8135b82a94b7 was accepted again on the same whitespace case with the same artifact hash, and op-c68b03671eac was accepted on the numeric case, grouping 0042/42/+42 and 0043/43 while leaving space-bearing keys separate. These observations support choosing op-6a6177cda758 for exact-string contracts, op-8135b82a94b7 for outer-whitespace contracts without numeric conversion, and op-c68b03671eac for whole-string ASCII integer equivalence without trimming, conditional on the tested v1 behavior. Those descriptions are inferred operation properties, not inspected implementations. Repeated identical keys, non-space Unicode whitespace, negative and zero values, large integers, non-ASCII digits, other nonmatching strings, and changed versions remain unverified."

      "text": "For current_version v1, choose by the requested payload precedence and by observed checkpoint completeness. Observed: op-e30c8efa3b18 passed both preserve-committed cases. In case-7f0012cb7d7a it inserted the missing input record before checkpoint 3, added the final input record, preserved the two differing committed values, and retained the outside record. On source-authoritative case-6910a46a6503 it still retained the two committed values; its process completed successfully but independent validation rejected the artifact. Thus it is supported for analogous preserve-committed imports and contradicted for this source-authoritative conflict case. Observed: op-14abd3b15139 passed the source-authoritative case, replacing both conflicting committed input values, adding both new IDs, and retaining the outside ID. This supports selecting it for analogous v1 source-authoritative inputs; its behavior on a missing checkpoint-prefix record or a preserve-committed contract remains untested here. Observed: op-dea403be5bde passed case-a7ba3cc7c70d where the checkpoint prefix was complete and values already agreed. It failed case-7f0012cb7d7a by omitting event-9e7a2083 before checkpoint 3, despite process success. The hypothesis that it trusts or skips the checkpoint prefix explains these two artifacts, but its implementation and general behavior were not inspected. Do not use its successful complete-prefix run as evidence that it repairs prefix gaps or resolves arbitrary payload conflicts. Inference: op-e30c8efa3b18 is the better-supported preserve-committed choice when prefix completeness is uncertain, and op-14abd3b15139 is the better-supported source-authoritative choice under the tested v1 conditions. These are conditional selections from six executions, not guarantees for other versions or untested inputs."
    },

      "source_kind": "judgment",
      "text": "For current_version v1, distinguish completeness from value precedence before selecting an operation. Observed: op-d2c64b0a8b6d was accepted on both preservation cases, retaining existing values and outside rows while adding missing IDs. In case-b1ab5b76ee86 it recovered an ID before checkpoint 3 despite conflicting source values. Op-a2227054a8a7 was accepted on the matching-value baseline and the source-authoritative case; in the latter it changed both existing prefix rows to source values and retained the outside row. These observations support choosing op-d2c64b0a8b6d for analogous preservation work and op-a2227054a8a7 for analogous source-authoritative work, with extrapolation beyond those inputs still an inference.\nObserved failures: op-3915cd13babb completed its process in both trials but was rejected by independent contract validation. It left a missing prefix ID absent in the preservation gap case and retained obsolete committed prefix values in the source-authoritative case. Skipping the checkpoint prefix is consistent with these outputs, but the implementation was not inspected. A checkpoint alone is therefore insufficient evidence of either complete prefix presence or correct prefix payloads. No tested condition establishes an accepted use of this operation.\nAll six outputs retained the outside row and showed no duplicate IDs, but this does not establish behavior for every input arrangement. The matching-value baseline cannot by itself distinguish preservation from source replacement. Check the final ID union, uniqueness, outside-row retention, and contract-specific payload values; process success alone did not establish correctness. All observations concern v1 only."

      "source_kind": "judgment",
      "text": "Observed at current_version v1: every trial completed with exit code 0 and status success, but two round-one artifacts failed independent contract validation. On case-928e0c58aefe, op-74444a2e0829 imported the missing prefix and suffix IDs and retained the outside ID, yet replaced both original committed values with source values; validation rejected that artifact under the preserve-committed contract. On the same case in round two, op-61a1ad3bbfbf preserved both committed values, recovered the missing ID before checkpoint 3, added the suffix ID, and retained the outside ID; validation accepted. On source-authoritative case-7785b78d62ed, op-61a1ad3bbfbf retained the two old committed values and validation rejected it, whereas op-74444a2e0829 wrote the required source values, added the new IDs, retained the outside ID, and validation accepted. Op-36ef9328143a was accepted in both rounds on case-9a261f6208d1, whose entire checkpoint prefix already existed with values equal to the source. These observations support this conditional v1 choice: when committed values must prevail, prefer op-61a1ad3bbfbf; when source values must prevail, prefer op-74444a2e0829. Those are inferences for similarly structured inputs, not verified claims about every input or internal implementation. Op-36ef9328143a is directly supported only for the tested complete, matching prefix; its conflict handling and missing-prefix recovery remain unknown. All six artifacts retained their outside ID, and the accepted artifacts satisfied the requested union and payload precedence in their respective cases. Completion alone did not establish correctness. Other versions and untested input conditions remain uncalibrated."

  "source_id": "judgment-b64972b79b702aa857d2e39ee7946f70227d8329e7ed9720d9475ca77fc28d77",
  "text": "For current_version v1, distinguish completeness from value precedence before selecting an operation. Observed: op-d2c64b0a8b6d was accepted on both preservation cases, retaining existing values and outside rows while adding missing IDs. In case-b1ab5b76ee86 it recovered an ID before checkpoint 3 despite conflicting source values. Op-a2227054a8a7 was accepted on the matching-value baseline and the source-authoritative case; in the latter it changed both existing prefix rows to source values and retained the outside row. These observations support choosing op-d2c64b0a8b6d for analogous preservation work and op-a2227054a8a7 for analogous source-authoritative work, with extrapolation beyond those inputs still an inference.\nObserved failures: op-3915cd13babb completed its process in both trials but was rejected by independent contract validation. It left a missing prefix ID absent in the preservation gap case and retained obsolete committed prefix values in the source-authoritative case. Skipping the checkpoint prefix is consistent with these outputs, but the implementation was not inspected. A checkpoint alone is therefore insufficient evidence of either complete prefix presence or correct prefix payloads. No tested condition establishes an accepted use of this operation.\nAll six outputs retained the outside row and showed no duplicate IDs, but this does not establish behavior for every input arrangement. The matching-value baseline cannot by itself distinguish preservation from source replacement. Check the final ID union, uniqueness, outside-row retention, and contract-specific payload values; process success alone did not establish correctness. All observations concern v1 only.",
  "world_id": "W06"
}

{
  "id": "judgment-cb906be247e8033893f058d2d8abb89027bfb23a644fa70531cada0da71deb39",
  "source_kind": "judgment",
  "text": "観測（提示された3ケースのcurrent_version=v1、2round計6実行）: R1のop-437293e17754は0017と外側空白付きの2文字列、18と外側空白付き文字列をそれぞれ結合し、17や+17とは分離した。完全一致要求では実行successでもaccepted=false、state_valid=falseだった。R1のop-56a851acc427は8キーをすべて単独にし、空白除去要求では同じ理由で不受理だった。R2では完全一致ケースへop-56a851acc427を選び8単独群、空白除去ケースへop-437293e17754を選び期待する5群となり、双方accepted=true、state_valid=trueだった。op-9112d954a9bcは両roundで0023・23・+23を結合し、0024・24を結合し、空白付きキーを分離する同一artifactとなり、数値同一性ケースで両回受理された。6実行のartifactは元recordsと全member IDを保持した。推定: 同様の入力とv1条件では完全一致にop-56a851acc427、外側空白除去後の文字列一致にop-437293e17754、全体がASCII整数形式の数値一致かつ空白非除去にop-9112d954a9bcが候補となる。これは観測からの役割推定であり、操作全域の仕様保証ではない。",
  "text_sha256": "debd1dae589449691b97345ae6b6cd2afd4ec1694a65ec4026e3993c9640a42d",
  "world_id": "W01"
}
judgment-90b047c638b44e308f4da3e6a63e2a59ce827477ecb3ecfbfb42f83bd9efb86b / judgment
{
  "id": "judgment-90b047c638b44e308f4da3e6a63e2a59ce827477ecb3ecfbfb42f83bd9efb86b",
  "source_kind": "judgment",
  "text": "Observed for the supplied v1 cases: all six operations completed successfully and preserved all eight original records and member IDs, but process success alone did not imply contract acceptance. In round one, op-c68b03671eac merged 0036, 36 and +36, and merged 0037 with 37, leaving space-bearing keys separate; exact-identity validation rejected it. Op-6a6177cda758 returned eight singletons on the numeric-identity case and was rejected because numeric-equivalent keys remained separate. Op-8135b82a94b7 grouped the outer-space variants of 0039 and 40 while separating 0039, 39 and +39; its whitespace-stripping case was accepted. In round two, op-6a6177cda758 was accepted on exact identity, op-8135b82a94b7 was accepted again on the same whitespace case with the same artifact hash, and op-c68b03671eac was accepted on the numeric case, grouping 0042/42/+42 and 0043/43 while leaving space-bearing keys separate. These observations support choosing op-6a6177cda758 for exact-string contracts, op-8135b82a94b7 for outer-whitespace contracts without numeric conversion, and op-c68b03671eac for whole-string ASCII integer equivalence without trimming, conditional on the tested v1 behavior. Those descriptions are inferred operation properties, not inspected implementations. Repeated identical keys, non-space Unicode whitespace, negative and zero values, large integers, non-ASCII digits, other nonmatching strings, and changed versions remain unverified.",
  "text_sha256": "8c1e12015f9845624e8f2e79d802f42fc7a7167db57acd26d52f32c872add41b",
  "world_id": "W02"
}

{
  "id": "judgment-28d66e14667a0364c8e438c40ea904becec390057ba790a5e3cbfce8ba5dcff5",
  "source_kind": "judgment",
  "text": "観測（すべてv1）: round1でop-a0ce1aa214bfはcase-f6b7c1801179の外側空白だけが違うキーをまとめ、完全一致契約には不合格だった。op-0a40894e4799はcase-c659d7a24190を8個の単独群にし、空白除去契約には不合格だった。両方とも処理はsuccess、exit_codeは0であり、契約不適合と処理完了は別だった。round2では前者を空白除去契約へ、後者を完全一致契約へ選び直し、それぞれ5群・8群でaccepted=trueかつstate_valid=trueとなった。op-4e79d2fdf83eはcase-851f97e72c1cの0061/61/+61と0062/62をまとめ、空白付きキーを別群にし、同じv1入力で両roundとも合格した。全6出力で元の8レコードと全member IDを保持していた。\n推定: 観測範囲ではop-0a40894e4799は文字列完全一致、op-a0ce1aa214bfは外側空白除去後の文字列一致、op-4e79d2fdf83eは空白を除去しない整数値一致に対応する。この対応は出力からの推定であり、実装を確認した事実ではない。\n適用条件と限界: この選択根拠は観測したv1と、正のASCII数字・先頭ゼロ・プラス符号・通常の外側空白を持つ3入力に限る。Unicode空白全般、負数、ゼロ、巨大整数、非ASCII数字、空文字、同一文字列の重複、非数値文字列の重複時の群化は未検証である。数値操作の同一入力での2回の合格は新しい入力領域の確認にはならない。",
  "text_sha256": "ca9f6cb0d4b4b3f4d3966920b9ce076539ee1b31903aa507a7d9bad9aea53d27",
  "world_id": "W03"
}
judgment-732f7ecee8d34e196b9610f52cd3d8d1d916a2bfbea11dbae056f19d0a80f881 / judgment
{
  "id": "judgment-732f7ecee8d34e196b9610f52cd3d8d1d916a2bfbea11dbae056f19d0a80f881",
  "source_kind": "judgment",
  "text": "For current_version v1, choose by the requested payload precedence and by observed checkpoint completeness. Observed: op-e30c8efa3b18 passed both preserve-committed cases. In case-7f0012cb7d7a it inserted the missing input record before checkpoint 3, added the final input record, preserved the two differing committed values, and retained the outside record. On source-authoritative case-6910a46a6503 it still retained the two committed values; its process completed successfully but independent validation rejected the artifact. Thus it is supported for analogous preserve-committed imports and contradicted for this source-authoritative conflict case. Observed: op-14abd3b15139 passed the source-authoritative case, replacing both conflicting committed input values, adding both new IDs, and retaining the outside ID. This supports selecting it for analogous v1 source-authoritative inputs; its behavior on a missing checkpoint-prefix record or a preserve-committed contract remains untested here. Observed: op-dea403be5bde passed case-a7ba3cc7c70d where the checkpoint prefix was complete and values already agreed. It failed case-7f0012cb7d7a by omitting event-9e7a2083 before checkpoint 3, despite process success. The hypothesis that it trusts or skips the checkpoint prefix explains these two artifacts, but its implementation and general behavior were not inspected. Do not use its successful complete-prefix run as evidence that it repairs prefix gaps or resolves arbitrary payload conflicts. Inference: op-e30c8efa3b18 is the better-supported preserve-committed choice when prefix completeness is uncertain, and op-14abd3b15139 is the better-supported source-authoritative choice under the tested v1 conditions. These are conditional selections from six executions, not guarantees for other versions or untested inputs.",
  "text_sha256": "4f992ade2d24724dbe74e1864cc73541dc74798fee2ead06d43b1e946b3542c1",
  "world_id": "W04"
}
judgment-6d7f8989071413eed2c28bb1fa61c3c18e6655ddfff951049b7d0223cd44835b / judgment
{
  "id": "judgment-6d7f8989071413eed2c28bb1fa61c3c18e6655ddfff951049b7d0223cd44835b",
  "source_kind": "judgment",
  "text": "Observed at current_version v1: every trial completed with exit code 0 and status success, but two round-one artifacts failed independent contract validation. On case-928e0c58aefe, op-74444a2e0829 imported the missing prefix and suffix IDs and retained the outside ID, yet replaced both original committed values with source values; validation rejected that artifact under the preserve-committed contract. On the same case in round two, op-61a1ad3bbfbf preserved both committed values, recovered the missing ID before checkpoint 3, added the suffix ID, and retained the outside ID; validation accepted. On source-authoritative case-7785b78d62ed, op-61a1ad3bbfbf retained the two old committed values and validation rejected it, whereas op-74444a2e0829 wrote the required source values, added the new IDs, retained the outside ID, and validation accepted. Op-36ef9328143a was accepted in both rounds on case-9a261f6208d1, whose entire checkpoint prefix already existed with values equal to the source. These observations support this conditional v1 choice: when committed values must prevail, prefer op-61a1ad3bbfbf; when source values must prevail, prefer op-74444a2e0829. Those are inferences for similarly structured inputs, not verified claims about every input or internal implementation. Op-36ef9328143a is directly supported only for the tested complete, matching prefix; its conflict handling and missing-prefix recovery remain unknown. All six artifacts retained their outside ID, and the accepted artifacts satisfied the requested union and payload precedence in their respective cases. Completion alone did not establish correctness. Other versions and untested input conditions remain uncalibrated.",
  "text_sha256": "2d5b941290c548180c5c1bae774d1896a54cda47c821ead3e575a8dcb5428d07",
  "world_id": "W05"
}
judgment-b64972b79b702aa857d2e39ee7946f70227d8329e7ed9720d9475ca77fc28d77 / judgment
{
  "id": "judgment-b64972b79b702aa857d2e39ee7946f70227d8329e7ed9720d9475ca77fc28d77",
  "source_kind": "judgment",
  "text": "For current_version v1, distinguish completeness from value precedence before selecting an operation. Observed: op-d2c64b0a8b6d was accepted on both preservation cases, retaining existing values and outside rows while adding missing IDs. In case-b1ab5b76ee86 it recovered an ID before checkpoint 3 despite conflicting source values. Op-a2227054a8a7 was accepted on the matching-value baseline and the source-authoritative case; in the latter it changed both existing prefix rows to source values and retained the outside row. These observations support choosing op-d2c64b0a8b6d for analogous preservation work and op-a2227054a8a7 for analogous source-authoritative work, with extrapolation beyond those inputs still an inference.\nObserved failures: op-3915cd13babb completed its process in both trials but was rejected by independent contract validation. It left a missing prefix ID absent in the preservation gap case and retained obsolete committed prefix values in the source-authoritative case. Skipping the checkpoint prefix is consistent with these outputs, but the implementation was not inspected. A checkpoint alone is therefore insufficient evidence of either complete prefix presence or correct prefix payloads. No tested condition establishes an accepted use of this operation.\nAll six outputs retained the outside row and showed no duplicate IDs, but this does not establish behavior for every input arrangement. The matching-value baseline cannot by itself distinguish preservation from source replacement. Check the final ID union, uniqueness, outside-row retention, and contract-specific payload values; process success alone did not establish correctness. All observations concern v1 only.",
  "text_sha256": "7cbd2c21321d861d7c7a69115ccb08df9bd6a8ff4e70a0ef2295e9f9a4ac139b",
  "world_id": "W06"
}

Observed: op-d2c64b0a8b6d was accepted on both preservation cases, retaining existing values and outside rows while adding missing IDs. In case-b1ab5b76ee86 it recovered an ID before checkpoint 3 despite conflicting source values. Op-a2227054a8a7 was accepted on the matching-value baseline and the source-authoritative case; in the latter it changed both existing prefix rows to source values and retained the outside row. These observations support choosing op-d2c64b0a8b6d for analogous preservation work and op-a2227054a8a7 for analogous source-authoritative work, with extrapolation beyond those inputs still an inference.\\nObserved failures: op-3915cd13babb completed its process in both trials but was rejected by independent contract validation. It left a missing prefix ID absent in the preservation gap case and retained obsolete committed prefix values in the source-authoritative case. Skipping the checkpoint prefix is consistent with these outputs, but the implementation was not inspected. A checkpoint alone is therefore insufficient evidence of either complete prefix presence or correct prefix payloads. No tested condition establishes an accepted use of this operation.\\nAll six outputs retained the outside row and showed no duplicate IDs, but this does not establish behavior for every input arrangement. The matching-value baseline cannot by itself distinguish preservation from source replacement. Check the final ID union, uniqueness, outside-row retention, and contract-specific payload values; process success alone did not establish correctness. Op-36ef9328143a is directly supported only for the tested complete, matching prefix; its conflict handling and missing-prefix recovery remain unknown. この試験が確かめた範囲。

2つの機構を各3historyで調べた小規模な人工課題です。全Wake・Emotion・AGI・脳・自然会話・重み学習の試験ではありません。

単一seedで作った6historyを各条件で対応させています。36の独立した経験ではありません。Aのheld-outは同じ8key関係で数値とIDを差し替えたもので、新構造への一般化ではありません。

provider・model・settings・tokens・computeは未確認のnullです。共有FS上の指示allowlistでありOS隔離ではありません。hashはlocal記録の整合性識別子で、外部署名やhardware attestationではありません。以前の12研究・data・replay・ZIPと4つのscroll storyは保持します。
